title: Fail-closed pre-push review with round budgets
summary: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is removed, so `osf review run` now exits non-zero on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run, and a new round budget kept in the journal state (outside the worktree) lets a push through after `in_sandbox_rounds` failed rounds while a could-not-run streak ends blocked with a message. A credential preflight decides a reviewer with no key and no login file before any worker starts, the work item can now come from `OSF_WORK_ITEM` when the file is missing, login-file secrets are scrubbed from transcripts, and osf's own untracked `.osf/` output no longer counts as part of the change.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/main.rs
lanes.summary: Argument parsing and exit codes. `--warn-only` is gone; `finish_review` now classifies the round and consults the budget.

lanes.label: Review run
lanes.subtitle: review_run, reviewers, review_context
lanes.summary: Setup, lens selection, reviewer launch, the credential preflight, the round counter and the work-item reader.

lanes.label: Journal state
lanes.subtitle: outside the worktree
lanes.summary: The per-worktree round counts, keyed by worktree path and hashed, so the builder cannot edit them.

lanes.label: Inputs and config
lanes.subtitle: osf.toml, moon task, work item
lanes.summary: The `[review]` settings, the pre-push moon task, and the work item body from a file or the environment.

nodes.label: review run / review reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code, review_reduce_exit_code
nodes.summary: Both commands lose `--warn-only` and always return their own code. `review run` counts rounds; `review reduce` never does, so the pull-request path stays a plain verdict gate.

nodes.label: finish_review
nodes.subtitle: verdict + kept findings -> exit code
nodes.summary: Prints the lines, writes SARIF, posts, then computes a base code from the verdict and whether any kept finding is must-fix or should-fix. When counting rounds it asks the budget whether the push may proceed.

nodes.label: review_base / round_kind
nodes.subtitle: Pass | Findings | CouldNotRun
nodes.summary: A could-not-run verdict spends the could-not-run budget even when another lens kept a finding; a pass with a blocking finding spends the findings budget.

nodes.label: review_run::run
nodes.subtitle: setup, run_reviewer, reduce
nodes.summary: Orchestrates lens selection, reviewer runs and the reducer. Setup now notes that `.osf/out` never reaches the changed-file list.

nodes.label: round_allows_push
nodes.subtitle: RoundCounts, RoundKind
nodes.summary: A pass clears the counts. A findings round increments and allows the push once past the limit. A could-not-run round increments and, past its own limit, returns an error naming the block instead of a pass.

nodes.label: preflight_and_not_run
nodes.subtitle: credential check before any worker
nodes.summary: Decides a reviewer's skip reason and, when no credential variable is set and every login path is missing, records every lens as could-not-run without starting a process.

nodes.label: Reviewer::missing_credentials
nodes.subtitle: templated, credential_env, login_paths
nodes.summary: Returns a reason only when the answer is deterministic: no templated command, a real home known, no non-empty credential variable, and every login path absent.

nodes.label: read_work_item
nodes.subtitle: file, then OSF_WORK_ITEM
nodes.summary: Falls back to the environment when no path is given or the file is missing; any other read error stays an error, and environment text is never parsed as the saved-JSON form.

nodes.label: secret_values::held
nodes.subtitle: login_values, json_leaves
nodes.summary: Adds every string leaf of the agents' JSON login files to the held-secret list, so a provider key in an auth file is scrubbed from transcripts.

nodes.label: changeset_risk::changed_files
nodes.subtitle: untracked .osf/ filtered
nodes.summary: Untracked paths under `.osf/` are dropped, so osf's own round counter or SARIF file cannot raise the tier or change lens selection between rounds.

nodes.label: review-rounds/<hash>.json
nodes.subtitle: journal state dir
nodes.summary: One JSON file per worktree holding `review` and `could_not_run` counts. Lives under the journal state directory, never in the worktree.

nodes.label: [review] config
nodes.subtitle: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
nodes.summary: Two new positive-integer settings, defaulting to 3 each, validated at load. `total_timeout_seconds` default drops from 2700 to 1800.

nodes.label: moon task: review
nodes.subtitle: osf review run --if-enabled
nodes.summary: Drops `--warn-only`, passes `--work-item .osf/out/work-item.txt`, and adds the work item file and `$OSF_WORK_ITEM` to its inputs so a changed work item cannot reuse a cached review.

nodes.label: work item body
nodes.subtitle: .osf/out/work-item.txt or OSF_WORK_ITEM
nodes.summary: The spec-and-acceptance lens needs this text. A hand push supplies the file or the variable; without either the review stops the push.

edges.label: count_rounds
edges.summary: The new gate: a kept finding or a could-not-run review now asks the budget before the push proceeds.

edges.label: load / save / clear
edges.summary: Counts live in the journal state, keyed by worktree, so the builder cannot edit them.

flows.title: Pre-push review round and its budget
flows.summary: What happens from the moon task to the exit code: the review runs, the verdict and kept findings are classified, and the round budget decides whether the push proceeds.

response.shape: { verdict: Verdict, findings: Vec<KeptFinding>, lines: Vec<String>, journal_error: Option<String> }

messages.label: review_base + round_kind
messages.note: A pass with a blocking finding is base 1 and spends the findings budget; a could-not-run verdict is base 2 and spends the could-not-run budget.

messages.label: true past the limit, false before
messages.note: A pass clears the file; a could-not-run streak past its limit returns an error and the push stays blocked.
